patch_list: Hides the transcribe button below voice messages in chats. Existing transcriptions and auto-transcribe are not changed.
Adds an "Oldest first" item to the menu of the inbox title. When it is on, the main inbox shows the oldest chats first. Pinned chats and the other spaces keep their order.
